observed.notes: The local btcs-l2 working tree also contains uncommitted btcs_nodeInfo and btcs_health diagnostics. They are excluded from this manifest until committed and documented; consumers must not rely on them.

semantics.feeDiscovery: read baseFeePerGas from eth_getBlockByNumber; eth_gasPrice is unavailable
semantics.receipt: null until included in a canonical block; status is 0x0 or 0x1
semantics.pendingPool: in-memory, development sequencer only; a missing receipt is not proof of non-submission

signing.reason: The node exposes no account or signing method. Applications must delegate signing to an injected wallet and submit eth_sendRawTransaction only if they hold a key.
signing.walletContract: EIP-1193 eth_requestAccounts + eth_sendTransaction against a wallet configured for chain 31337

trust: Single trusted development sequencer; no independent verification of execution.
The RPC operator can lie about balances, blocks, and receipts.
Inclusion in a canonical local block is not finality and is not settlement.
No validity proof, no L1 anchor enforcement, and no trustless exit is exercised by these methods.
Chain ID 31337 is shared by unrelated local chains; the BTCSL2/ banner is the additional identity check.

knownGaps.impact: A browser page on another origin cannot call the RPC directly.
knownGaps.requestedChange: Send CORS headers for loopback development, or document a required same-origin reverse proxy.

knownGaps.impact: Browser wallets and ethers v6 request nonces with the pending tag and fail with -32602.
knownGaps.requestedChange: Accept pending as an alias for the sequencer view, or document that clients must use latest.

knownGaps.impact: Wallets cannot use eth_gasPrice or eth_feeHistory.
knownGaps.requestedChange: Implement eth_gasPrice and eth_feeHistory, or document base-fee-only fee construction.

knownGaps.impact: Only the genesis fixture account holds BTCS; an arbitrary injected-wallet account cannot be funded.
knownGaps.requestedChange: Provide a local-only funding method (for example btcs_dev_fund) gated behind --dev-sequencer.

knownGaps.impact: No address index; history requires bounded block scans.
knownGaps.requestedChange: Document that history is not an RPC capability; an indexer is a separate service.

readOnlyClient.status: unreleased source; read-only, no signing or submission
readOnlyClient.notes: 13 tests: 12 pass, 1 live integration test skipped unless BTCS_L2_RPC_URL is set. Schema and type checks pass.

silverPayWallet.status: local development prototype; watch-only reads, ERC-20 tracking, bounded history, and injected-wallet send preparation
silverPayWallet.notes: 70 tests: 69 pass, 1 skipped without a dev key; production build succeeds. Injected-wallet signing is unverified because the node rejects the pending block tag.

silverForgeStudio.status: local development profile verified against this interface
silverForgeStudio.notes: 17 tests: 16 pass, 1 live deployment skipped without a dev key; the live ERC-20 deployment passes when the harness key is supplied.
